title: Multipurpose dynamo that's a must-have in the kitchen
text:
Multipurpose dynamo that's a must-have in the kitchen. Oxo's Good Grips Pastry Scraper is an indispensable tool in the kitchen, not just for dough scraping / dividing, but also for cutting brownies and fudge, chopping chocolate, and even chopping nuts and veggies.

Hefty in the hand, the pastry scraper is a substantial weight with an ergonomic handle that makes it easy to hold onto. However, the blade is lethally sharp; be particularly cautious if you're chopping something hard like carrots where the blade is likely to bounce or slip; a trip to the emergency room might result (haven't had it happen with this, but two of my (klutzy) family members sliced themselves open on the [[ASIN:B000AREB5S OXO Good Grips Mango Splitter]] blade). This is an invaluable tool for slicing brownies or bar cookies in the pan, for dividing yeast doughs before baking, and for chopping last-minute ingredients; in fact, you might want to order two, since this might become your favorite kitchen tool.

description: OXO Good Grips Stainless Steel Scraper & ChopperNamed for its shape, the Y Peeler features a sharp, stainless steel blade that glides through even the toughest fruit and vegetable skins with ease. The soft, comfortable handle cushions your hand as you peel, and is non-slip, even when your hands are wet.OXO Good Grips Swivel PeelerThe OXO Good Grips Swivel Peeler is perfect for prepping tough-skinned fruits and vegetables. Twin stainless steel blades flex to remove large swaths of skin with each stroke. The comfortable, oversized handle was designed for fast, repetitive use and won’t slip, even when wet. A durable, built-in eye remover carves out blemishes without ruining your produce. The Peeler is dishwasher safe and includes a large in-handle hole for simple storage.
